# crosswork_l3vpn_vpn_services (Data Source)

This data source can read an L3VPN service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_l3vpn_vpn_services" "example" {
  id     = "cwtest-svc"
  vpn_id = "cwtest-svc"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `vpn_id` (String) Name of the service. Letters, digits and `-`, at most 32 characters.

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `auto_hub_rt` (Boolean) Marks the hub route target as taken from the NSO pool. Needs the topology any-to-any or hub-spoke. Set to `true` or leave unset.
- `auto_spoke_rt` (Boolean) Marks the spoke route target as taken from the NSO pool. Needs the topology hub-spoke. Set to `true` or leave unset.
- `service_assurance_monitoring_state` (String) Monitoring state. `pause` can be set only while the state is `enable`.
- `service_assurance_preservation` (String) What happens to the monitoring data when the service is removed
- `service_assurance_profile_name` (String) Service assurance profile, which has to exist in Crosswork (the name of a system profile ends in a space and `system`)
- `service_assurance_rule_name` (String) Service assurance rule, which has to exist in Crosswork
- `vpn_instance_profiles` (Attributes List) Profiles of the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpn_instance_profiles))
- `vpn_nodes` (Attributes List) Nodes of the service. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpn_nodes))
- `vpn_service_topology` (String) Topology of the service

<a id="nestedatt--vpn_instance_profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vpn_instance_profiles`

Read-Only:

- `address_families` (Attributes List) Address families of the profile (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpn_instance_profiles--address_families))
- `local_as` (Number) Autonomous system of the profile
- `profile_id` (String) Name of the profile
- `rd` (String) Route distinguisher as type:administrator:value. NSO uses rd auto when it is left out. Changing it replaces the service.
- `role` (String) Role of the profile in a hub and spoke service

<a id="nestedatt--vpn_instance_profiles--address_families"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vpn_instance_profiles.address_families`

Read-Only:

- `address_family` (String) Address family
- `export_policy` (String) Name of the route policy that is applied to the routes that are exported
- `import_policy` (String) Name of the route policy that is applied to the routes that are imported
- `vpn_targets` (Attributes List) Route targets of the family (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpn_instance_profiles--address_families--vpn_targets))

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Number of the group of route targets
- `route_target_type` (String) Whether the targets are imported, exported or both
- `route_targets` (Attributes List) Route targets of the group (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpn_instance_profiles--address_families--vpn_targets--route_targets))

<a id="nestedatt--vpn_instance_profiles--address_families--vpn_targets--route_targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vpn_instance_profiles.address_families.vpn_targets.route_targets`

Read-Only:

- `route_target` (String) Route target as type:administrator:value

Read-Only:

- `active_vpn_instance_profiles` (Attributes List) Profiles that the node uses, with the values that replace the profile on this node (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpn_nodes--active_vpn_instance_profiles))

<a id="nestedatt--vpn_nodes--vpn_network_accesses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vpn_nodes.vpn_network_accesses`

Read-Only:

- `cvlan_id` (Number) VLAN of the dot1q sub-interface
- `encapsulation_type` (String) Encapsulation type
- `id` (String) Identifier of the access
- `interface_id` (String) Interface of the access. A dot1q access becomes a sub-interface.
- `ipv4_address` (String) IPv4 address of the access
- `ipv4_prefix_length` (Number) Prefix length of the IPv4 address
- `ipv6_address` (String) IPv6 address of the access
- `ipv6_prefix_length` (Number) Prefix length of the IPv6 address
- `mtu` (Number) MTU of the access. NSO refuses it on a Loopback.
- `qos_profiles` (Attributes List) QoS profiles of the access (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpn_nodes--vpn_network_accesses--qos_profiles))
- `routing_protocols` (Attributes List) Routing protocols of the access. A route policy of the profile is pushed only when there is one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpn_nodes--vpn_network_accesses--routing_protocols))

<a id="nestedatt--vpn_nodes--vpn_network_accesses--qos_profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vpn_nodes.vpn_network_accesses.qos_profiles`

Read-Only:

- `direction` (String) wan-to-site is the input and site-to-wan the output of the interface
- `profile` (String) Name of a QoS profile id; the device needs a policy-map of that name


<a id="nestedatt--vpn_nodes--vpn_network_accesses--routing_protocols"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vpn_nodes.vpn_network_accesses.routing_protocols`

Read-Only:

- `bgp_address_family` (String) Address family of the BGP neighbors
- `bgp_multihop` (Number) Number of hops to the BGP neighbors
- `bgp_neighbors` (Set of String) BGP neighbors, IPv4 or IPv6 addresses
- `bgp_peer_as` (Number) Autonomous system of the BGP neighbors
- `bgp_redistribute_connected` (Attributes List) Connected routes that BGP redistributes. Only an entry with enable set to true is pushed to the device. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpn_nodes--vpn_network_accesses--routing_protocols--bgp_redistribute_connected))
- `bgp_update_source_if_id` (String) Interface number of the BGP update source
- `bgp_update_source_if_type` (String) Interface type of the BGP update source
- `bgp_update_source_sub_if_id` (Number) Sub-interface number of the BGP update source
- `id` (String) Identifier of the routing protocol
- `type` (String) Routing protocol

<a id="nestedatt--vpn_nodes--vpn_network_accesses--routing_protocols--bgp_redistribute_connected"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vpn_nodes.vpn_network_accesses.routing_protocols.bgp_redistribute_connected`

Read-Only:

- `address_family` (String) Address family
- `enable` (Boolean) Redistribute the connected routes of the family
- `metric` (Number) Metric of the redistributed routes
